requirements: Every source-verified cost must include source URL, source family, retrieved_at, patch_version, and claim_id.
Every missing cost must use pending_allowed_source_refresh, not silent null.
Patch-changed costs override stale wiki values only when supported by Riot patch source.
WildRiftFire can support advisory meta existence but exact gold values must be source_verified only when extracted from approved source text.
Cost conflicts must produce a source_conflict record.
